references.text: The book of Psalms highlights the importance of not repaying evil with evil, which resonates with Jesus' call to not resist the one who is evil.
John's account of how Jesus handled being struck during his trial illustrates the principle he taught in Matthew 5:39.
Proverbs urges us not to say, "I will do to him as he has done to me," supporting Jesus' teaching on not resisting the one who is evil.
Paul's letter to the Romans repeats Jesus' command to not repay evil with evil and to overcome evil with good.
Joseph's words to his brothers that what they meant for evil, God meant for good, illustrate the principle of not resisting the one who is evil.
